title: strlen counts the number of bytes
summary: The character U+4E2D occupies three bytes in UTF-8, so strlen returns 3.
detail: PHP strings can contain NUL. strlen("A\0B") returns 3 because the escape in the double-quoted literal produces a NUL byte.
boundary: The number of bytes, the number of Unicode code points, and the terminal display width are different quantities.
relevance: Avoid truncating multibyte data by the number of characters displayed when slicing based on the record length field.
